passage_intro: Now, let's read. Listen and repeat.

phrases.en: My favorite festival is Children's Day.
phrases.zh: 我最喜欢的节日是儿童节。
phrases.py: wǒ zuì xǐ huān de jié rì shì ér tóng jié。
wǒ dé dào yí gè xiǎo lǐ wù。

phrases.en: My family goes to the park.
phrases.py: wǒ men jiā rén qù gōng yuán。

phrases.en: We sing a song, and we play together.
phrases.py: wǒ men chàng gē， yě yì qǐ wán。
měi gè rén dōu hěn kuài lè。

phrases.en: This festival is for children, and I am thirteen.
phrases.ko: 이 축제는 아이들을 위한 것이고, 나는 열세 살이에요.
phrases.zh: 这个节日是给孩子的，我十三岁。
phrases.py: zhè ge jié rì shì gěi hái zi de， wǒ shí sān suì。

phrases.en: In May the park is full of families.
phrases.zh: 五月的公园里满是一家人。
phrases.py: wǔ yuè de gōng yuán lǐ mǎn shì yī jiā rén。

phrases.en: A small gift can still make a big smile.
phrases.ko: 작은 선물도 큰 미소를 만들 수 있어요.
phrases.zh: 小礼物也能带来大大的微笑。
phrases.py: xiǎo lǐ wù yě néng dài lái dà dà de wēi xiào。

phrases.en: We sing a song together and clap.
phrases.ko: 우리는 함께 노래를 부르고 박수를 쳐요.
phrases.py: wǒ men yì qǐ chàng gē， hái pāi shǒu。

phrases.en: I like this festival because we are happy together.
phrases.ko: 우리는 함께 행복해서 나는 이 축제를 좋아해요.
phrases.zh: 我们一起很快乐，所以我喜欢这个节日。
phrases.py: wǒ men yì qǐ hěn kuài lè， suǒ yǐ wǒ xǐ huān zhè ge jié rì。

full_passage_lines.en: My favorite festival is Children's Day.
My family goes to the park.
We sing a song, and we play together.
This festival is for children, and I am thirteen.
full_passage_lines.ko: 이 축제는 아이들을 위한 것이고, 나는 열세 살이에요.

full_passage_lines.en: In May the park is full of families.
A small gift can still make a big smile.
full_passage_lines.ko: 작은 선물도 큰 미소를 만들 수 있어요.

full_passage_lines.en: We sing a song together and clap.
full_passage_lines.ko: 우리는 함께 노래를 부르고 박수를 쳐요.

full_passage_spoken: My favorite festival is Children's Day. It is in May. I get a small gift. My family goes to the park. We sing a song, and we play together. Everyone is happy. This festival is for children, and I am thirteen. In May the park is full of families. A small gift can still make a big smile. We sing a song together and clap. I like this festival because we are happy together.
topic_pinyin: wǒ zuì xǐ huān de jié rì
full_passage_zh: 我最喜欢的节日是儿童节。它在五月。我得到一个小礼物。我们家人去公园。我们唱歌，也一起玩。每个人都很快乐。这个节日是给孩子的，我十三岁。五月的公园里满是一家人。小礼物也能带来大大的微笑。我们一起唱歌，还拍手。我们一起很快乐，所以我喜欢这个节日。
full_passage_pinyin: wǒ zuì xǐ huān de jié rì shì ér tóng jié。 tā zài wǔ yuè。 wǒ dé dào yí gè xiǎo lǐ wù。 wǒ men jiā rén qù gōng yuán。 wǒ men chàng gē， yě yì qǐ wán。 měi gè rén dōu hěn kuài lè。 zhè ge jié rì shì gěi hái zi de， wǒ shí sān suì。 wǔ yuè de gōng yuán lǐ mǎn shì yī jiā rén。 xiǎo lǐ wù yě néng dài lái dà dà de wēi xiào。 wǒ men yì qǐ chàng gē， hái pāi shǒu。 wǒ men yì qǐ hěn kuài lè， suǒ yǐ wǒ xǐ huān zhè ge jié rì。
